dict.string: Sotto listens only when you activate voice input.
Sotto transcribes your spoken commands using Apple Speech.
Sotto controls macOS settings and supported apps like Spotify, Apple Notes and Apple Mail when you ask.
Sotto finds people you ask about and saves contact changes only after you review them.
Sotto creates and lists reminders when you ask.
Sotto reads your calendar and adds events only when you ask. It verifies created events and never sends invitations.
